http_send_request.why: Rewrites <service>.rec.net hosts to <service>.<ServerHost> before a request is queued.

http_call_callback.why: Logs each finished request's status (and the body of non-2xx responses).

oculus_get_app_id.why: Returns the operator's Meta app id when OculusAppId is set.

oculus_get_mobile_app_id.why: Same as get_AppID; the Quest build reads this getter.

photon_app_settings.why: Builds Photon.Realtime.AppSettings with Rec Room's hardcoded Realtime/Voice app ids (PC: same class+method). Postfixed to set the operator's ids.

tls_unity_verify.why: Platform TLS trust decision (Mono's bundled CA set). Forced to success when TlsTrustBypass is on.

tls_bc_notify_server_certificate.why: BestHTTP BouncyCastle trust hook (PC ClientMod skips the same method). No-op when TlsTrustBypass is on.

pin_nameserver.why: Name-server client's certificate callback: chain status + SPKI pin compare. Always accepted (pins never match a self-hosted server).

pin_https.why: SPKI pinning for every RecNet request; a miss reports NetworkCertificateMismatch through FPIBGPIAOBI. Always accepted.

pin_bc_verifier.why: The same pin check as an ICertificateVerifyer for the BouncyCastle path. Always accepted.

image_signature_verify.why: RSA-SHA1 check of image Content-Signature against Rec Room's baked public key. Accepted when AcceptUnsignedImages is on.

hile_warning_callback.why: Cheat-warning dialog/quit callback. Skipped, as on PC.

unknown_dll_callback.why: Unknown-library detection callback (the injected hook library is one). Skipped, as on PC (PC closure class is PNHDGEKCJCH).

file_hash_callback.why: File-hash checker result callback (the APK is re-signed). Skipped, as on PC.

toxmod_can_initialize.why: Third-party voice moderation service; forced false, as on PC.

cheat_report.why: Log-only: names any integrity report so a new one is visible in logcat.

fatal_application_quit.why: Log-only: prints the quit reason and caller.

try_application_quit.why: Log-only: prints the quit code and caller.
